title: athyrium schimperi subsp. biserrulatum
intro: Athyrium schimperi subsp. biserrulatum, commonly known as the African lady fern, is a species of fern in the family Athyriaceae. It is traditionally used in folk medicine for its health benefits, which include treating fever, cough, and respiratory issues due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial activity, making it effective in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Athyrium schimperi subsp. biserrulatum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
